q2_gaps: An in-world calendar date ("on day 425 of Year 2"): the structured Time terms (Day n)/(Year n) are specified for Gregorian dates, and a day-of-year number far above 31 plus a bare regnal year are not addressed.

A container/measure partitive NP ("one vessel of mire-essence"): the genitive section explicitly excludes measure of-phrases ("a cup of water") but no section says how to encode one, so the Measure-with-unspecified-scale form used here is an improvisation.

A plural kind word inside a multi-word proper name ("the Salt-bloom Tide-pools"): the Kestrel-River rule licenses a type atom from a kind word inside the name (here singular, (Member ... tide_pool)), while the plural-label rule ("the Wrens") bars any per-member kind from a plural label word, and nothing resolves which governs.

An explicit "no" over a mass noun in a one-off episodic denial ("No mire-essence formed in Cauldron Three"): the QuantifierPhrase companion is called mandatory for every explicit quantifier word, yet a witness-based strength-0 bundle quantifies no range for the companion to restate, so whether "no" and plain "not" stay distinguishable here is unsettled.
notes: The "filled X with sea-water" phrases route the substance to Instrument, which the with-phrase test (participant to CoAgent, means to Instrument; substances allowed) does license, and it is applied consistently across all three fills. Group/count/PartOf handling of the three named cauldrons, the Location-on-event-only rule for the forming events, and the negated bundle's placement of the mass witness inside the denial all follow the instruction set.
